title: Five German mountaineers die in northern Italy after being hit by avalanche
summary: Mountaineers struck by avalanche on Saturday while climbing near the Cima Vertana, in the Ortles mountains Five German mountaineers died after being hit by an avalanche in northern Italy, rescuers said. The bodies of three victims – two men and a woman – had been recovered on Saturday, while the bodies of two other missing people, a man and his 17-year-old daughter, were found on Sunday morning.
